note: Templates for the live What-happened story. {placeholders} are filled by tools/build_story.py from data, never typed. Keep sentences under 20 words, age-12 reading level, hedge every flood claim. Needs domain-expert review before real numbers go live.

placeholders.n_prev: mandals probably flooded on the previous pass
placeholders.n_now: mandals probably flooded on this pass
placeholders.lik_then: share on the earlier pass, in 100 acres

recovery.most: Most of the flooded land around {event} has probably drained.
recovery.partial: Some of the land flooded by {event} has probably drained. Some is still wet.
recovery.little: Most of the land probably flooded by {event} still looks wet in the latest radar picture.

headline.worse: More land is probably flooded than on the last radar pass.
headline.first_pass: First radar picture after {event}: some land was probably under water.
headline.no_new_pass: No new radar picture yet. This page shows the last one, from {date}.
headline.watch: Calm on the coast. No active storm.
headline.no_flood: No land looks probably flooded in this radar picture.

lead.recovery: The satellite looked again on {date}, {days_after} days after landfall. The numbers are likely to change as more radar pictures arrive.
lead.first_pass: NISAR looked at the coast on {date}. Radar change points to places that were probably under water.
lead.watch: No storm is being tracked right now. The latest radar picture is from {date}.
lead.landfall_day: NISAR looked at the coast on {date}, the day {event} reached land. Radar change points to places that were probably under water.

since_last.title: Since the last pass
since_last.text: Between {prev_date} and {date}, {n_prev} mandals were probably flooded and now {n_now} are. {receded} went down, {still} stayed about the same, {worse} went up.
since_last.since_landfall: Since the landfall pass, the share in {top_mandal} has gone from about {lik_then} to about {lik} in every 100 acres.

top_mandal.label: of {top_mandal} was probably under water, give or take {err}

change.label: change in {top_mandal} since the last radar pass

days_after.label: after the storm reached land, when this radar picture was taken

days_to_next.label: until the next radar pass, about

eye_radius.label: wide, the calm centre (eye) of the storm in the radar picture, give or take {err}

mandal.trend_down: The share here has probably gone down since {prev_date}.
mandal.trend_flat: There is no clear change here since {prev_date}.
mandal.trend_up: The share here has probably gone up since {prev_date}.
mandal.trend_new: This is the first radar picture for this mandal.
mandal.not_enough_view: The radar did not see enough of this mandal to say.
mandal.ask_officials: This is a guide to where to look. Ask your local officials.
mandal.main: About {lik} in every 100 acres of {mandal} were probably under water on {date}, give or take {err}.
mandal.low: Little sign of new open water in {mandal}: about {lik} in every 100 acres, give or take {err}.

provisional: Early data. NISAR has not finished checking it. Numbers may change.
missing_numbers: Pictures are ready, numbers are coming.
stale: No new radar pass in {days} days. This page shows the last one, from {date}.
next_pass: Next radar pass expected about {next_date}. This is a schedule estimate. It can shift.

watch.normal_check: Every mandal is inside its normal range on the latest pass.
watch.flood_signal: Some mandals still show probable open water. Ask your local officials.

official_banner: This is not an official warning. For alerts, follow IMD, APSDMA and your district officers.
next_pass_overdue: The next radar pass was expected about {next_date}. It can shift.

update.coast_first: Radar picture of the coast on {date}.
update.coast_summary: Radar points to about {km2} square km of new open water ({lo} to {hi} with other settings). That is {times} a normal fortnight.
update.sea_eye: Radar picture of the sea on {date}, with the calm centre (eye) of {event}.
update.sea_after: Radar picture of the sea on {date}.
update.sea_diff: The sea looks brighter than on a calm day ({ref_date}). That is where wind roughened the water.
